x.description: `Tensor` to conjugate. Must have numeric or variant type.
constraints: If x is a complex number tensor, the elements must be of the form \(a + bj\), where `a` and `b` are real numbers. The returned tensor will be of the form \(a - bj\).
If x is not a complex number tensor, it will return a tensor of the same type as input but with float32 or complex128 dtype.

output.description: A `Tensor` that is the conjugate of `x` (with the same type).
